description_en: Creates a virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall to protect mutual access traffic between network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance and a specified VPC
description_zh: 创建VPC边界防火墙（防护云企业网内的网络实例和指定VPC之间的互访流量）
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-vpc-firewall-cen-configure --lang zh --vpc-firewall-name vpc-firewall-test --network-instance-id vpc-bp10zlifxh6j0232w0000 --vpc-region cn-hangzhou --firewall-switch open --cen-id cen-x5jayxou71ad730000 --member-uid 2580394279020000 --vswitch-id vsw-qzeaol304m000 --firewall-vpc-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/8 --firewall-vpc-zone-id cn-hangzhou-a --firewall-vswitch-cidr-block 10.0.0.0/28 --firewall-vpc-standby-zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVpcFirewallCenConfigure

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文。

- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The instance name of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙的实例名称
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC for which you want to create a VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh: 创建VPC边界防火墙的VPC实例ID
parameters.name: network_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC for which you want to create a VPC firewall.

> For more information about the regions supported by Cloud Firewall, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建VPC边界防火墙的VPC所属地域ID。

> 关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: vpc_region

parameters.help_en:
The status of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall after you create a VPC firewall. Valid values:

- **open** (default): The VPC firewall is automatically enabled after it is created.
- **close**: The VPC firewall is not automatically enabled after it is created. You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345780.html operation to enable the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh:
设置VPC边界防火墙的开关状态。取值：

- **open**（默认）：创建VPC边界防火墙后自动开启防护。
- **close**：创建VPC边界防火墙后不自动开启防护。您可以调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345780.html开启防护
parameters.name: firewall_switch

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the Cloud Firewall interface belongs
parameters.help_zh: 指定云防火墙接口所属的vSwitch ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block of the VPC used by the firewall. Specify a CIDR block with a subnet mask of no more than 28 bits. This CIDR block is allocated to the VPC that is created during the process to create a VPC firewall (Cloud_Firewall_VPC) for traffic redirection.

If you leave this parameter empty, the default CIDR block 10.0.0.0/8 is automatically allocated.

> This parameter takes effect only when a VPC firewall is created for the first time in the local region of the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所使用VPC网段, 需配置子网掩码不大于28位网段来分配给创建防火墙过程所需VPC网段，用以自动创建防火墙安全VPC（Cloud_Firewall_VPC）进行流量引流处理。

如果不填此参数，则默认自动分配网段10.0.0.0/8。

> 参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary active zone to which the firewall belongs. If your business is latency-sensitive, you can set the firewall zone to the same zone as the vSwitch of the business VPC to reduce latency.

If you leave this parameter empty, a default zone is automatically allocated for the firewall.



> This parameter takes effect only when a VPC firewall is created for the first time in the local region of the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所属的主可用区ID。
如果您的业务延时敏感，您可以自定义防火墙可用区和业务VPC交换机可用区相同，以便降低延时。

如果不填此参数，则默认自动分配防火墙可用区。



> 参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The CIDR block of the vSwitch used by the firewall. Specify a CIDR block with a subnet mask of no more than 29 bits that does not conflict with your network planning. This CIDR block is allocated to the vSwitch that is created during the process to create a VPC firewall within the firewall security VPC (Cloud_Firewall_VSWITCH) for traffic redirection. The vSwitch CIDR block must be a subnet of the firewall VPC CIDR block.

If you leave this parameter empty, the default CIDR block 10.219.219.216/29 is automatically allocated.

> This parameter takes effect only when a VPC firewall is created for the first time in the local region of the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所使用vSwitch网段, 需配置子网掩码不大于29位且不与网络规划冲突的网段来分配给创建防火墙过程所需vSwitch网段，用以自动创建防火墙安全VPC内的交换机（Cloud_Firewall_VSWITCH）进行流量引流处理。交换机网段必须是防火墙VPC网段的子网。

如果不填此参数, 则默认自动分配网段10.219.219.216/29。

> 参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vswitch_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the secondary zone to which the firewall belongs. The firewall performs an automatic switchover to the secondary zone to continue running only when the primary zone becomes unavailable.

If you leave this parameter empty, a default secondary zone is automatically allocated for the firewall.



> This parameter takes effect only when a VPC firewall is created for the first time in the local region of the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
防火墙所属的备可用区ID。只有防火墙主可用区服务不可用时, 防火墙会自动切换到备可用区继续运行。

如果不填此参数，则默认自动分配防火墙备可用区。



> 参数仅本CEN本地域首次创建VPC防火墙时有效
parameters.name: firewall_vpc_standby_zone_id
